feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: U.S. to issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro as his whereabouts remain unclear
entry.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for the U.S. amid a money-laundering probe, as Washington agrees to issue visas to him and his family.

entry.title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
entry.summary: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

entry.title: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
entry.summary: The current outbreak, first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now counted 10,000 patients and has spread with great speed. How can it be stopped?

entry.title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
entry.summary: Brazil's opposition party accepts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's election victory, but Flávio Bolsonaro won't concede, while President Trump calls the vote "rigged" without offering evidence.

entry.title: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
entry.summary: In Nairobi, a city prone to floods, workers in the "Green Army" are making preparations to prevent disaster when El Niño arrives.

entry.title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
entry.summary: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership.

entry.title: Local ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump starts in southern Ukraine
entry.summary: A localized ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect early Tuesday ahead of a humanitarian mission brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump, as missile attacks resumed in Kyiv.

entry.title: A quick guide to Israel's high-stakes election
entry.summary: Israel is holding its first elections since the Hamas-led attacks of 2023 triggered a chain of conflicts across the region — a quick guide the key players, issues and when to expect a result.

entry.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
entry.summary: Andre McKechnie, 55, is serving a life sentence for murder. He took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the court last year. He argued being refused Vegemite breached the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act.

entry.title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
entry.summary: This closed-door gathering that started Monday comes about a year before Xi is expected to secure a fourth term and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.
